d_text: Urine pregnancy test: negative (one line, at the control mark only).
Urine pregnancy test: positive (two lines, at the control mark and the test mark).
Urine dipstick: leukocytes negative, nitrite negative, protein negative, blood negative, glucose negative, ketones negative.
Urine dipstick: leukocytes ++, nitrite positive, protein trace, blood trace, glucose negative, ketones negative. Suggests a urinary tract infection.
Urine dipstick: glucose ++++, ketones +++, protein trace, leukocytes negative, nitrite negative, blood negative. Suspected diabetic ketoacidosis.
Urine dipstick: blood +++, protein trace, leukocytes negative, nitrite negative, glucose negative, ketones negative. Blood in the urine (haematuria).
Sample appearance after centrifugation: serum clear and straw-coloured; no haemolysis, no lipaemia.
Sample appearance after centrifugation: serum pink to red, haemolysis visible. Potassium and some other results are unreliable; repeat the sample.
Sample appearance after centrifugation: serum cloudy and milky, lipaemia visible. Some results may be unreliable; the lab will comment.
